intelligence.enrichment: A parallelogram is a quadrilateral with both pairs of opposite sides parallel; rectangles and squares are special parallelograms because their opposite sides are parallel.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Mathematics question. Chapter: math/grade_08/ch_104. The student must decide: Is a quadrilateral a parallelogram, and do rectangles or squares belong inside that set? Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Supply exactly one complete tikzpicture. The stem must refer to that figure. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
